arm_state.attribution_caveat: KAPSO records this score as a `full`-fidelity attempt under the *registered evaluator's* id (record_evaluation_attempt, registered_evaluation.py:124-159, never consults the manifest), so node.evaluation_attempts, evidence tiers, get_deliverable_score and the MCP experiment memory will attribute the harness's number to the registered evaluator. KAPSO cannot distinguish a harness outcome from its own measurement. A1 must therefore NOT treat KAPSO's ledger as evaluator-realisation evidence; the realisation evidence is the harness's own ledger (a0/a1/eval_service.py) and the a0/envelope measurement token.
